name: Glory Days Grille

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.claim: Glory Days Grill provides current nutrition and food-allergy information based on approved-vendor data, while warning that ingredients may change and guests should confirm at the time of dining.

Deep-fried items use a shared fryer with beef tallow and carry a high cross-contact risk; normal cooking operations also create cross-contact risk, so guests with allergies should speak with the manager before ordering.
